title.en: An Act Converting the Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Bayugan, Province of Agusan Del Sur, Into a Regular District Office, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Bayugan, Province of Agusan Del Sur, Into a Regular District Office, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng vệ tinh Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy tại Thành phố Bayugan, Tỉnh Agusan Del Sur, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานดาวเทียม Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติ ในเมือง Bayugan จังหวัด Agusan Del Sur และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Satelit Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Reguler di Kota Bayugan, Provinsi Agusan Del Sur, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Satelit Land Transportation Office kepada Pejabat Daerah Biasa di Bandar Bayugan, Wilayah Agusan Del Sur, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Bayugan, Province of Agusan del Sur, is hereby converted into a regular district office to be known as the LTO District Office.

The Secretary of Transportation shall include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the LTO district office in the City of Bayugan, Province of Agusan del Sur, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
